services.name: Morning 4 Hour Private Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy your beautiful day on your private Cruise! 4 Hours About: Enjoy a boat tour of Destin Harbor (if you choose), and Captain Walt , and crew will show you the best of Destin from the water. We will look for dolphins, while headed to Crab Island, where we will anchor for a fun filled day of sun, music and great food. You can search for Hermit Crabs, Sand Dollars and bring your snorkel gear too. Captain Walt and crew will supply all the toys, and do all the work, while you enjoy. The day is all about you! blurb: Crab Island is a sandbar located North of the Marler Bridge in Destin, FL. Crab Island started to gain in popularity as boaters used the area to anchor their boats to catch some rays and wade on the sandbar. The spot has erupted into a popular social scene where locals and tourists congregate for fun and sun. Crab Island is just minutes from the Destin Harbor.
